objects.dialogueText: COGS FOUND: {v1} OF 3. THE RUST KING STOLE THEM FROM OUR CLOCK!
dialogueMore: ONE IS IN THE GEARWORKS MINE, ONE IN THE SUNKEN CISTERN, ONE AT THE TOP OF THE BELL TOWER.

BRING ALL THREE COGS HOME AND THE FORGE GATE WILL OPEN.
